findings: 410 swallowed in fetchComplianceRuns — the throw inside fetchComplianceRuns sits within a try/catch {} that returns [] on any error. The 410 message never reaches the caller; the UI silently shows an empty run list instead of surfacing 'This endpoint has moved. Please refresh the page.' Fix: remove the outer try/catch or rethrow on 410 specifically.

E2ERunResult in api.ts diverges from compliance.types.ts — api.ts defines its own E2ERunResult with steps: E2EStep[] (required) and no temporal_run_id or hitl_required fields. Callers importing from api.ts see the old shape and miss the new fields at compile time. Fix: delete the duplicate definition and import E2ERunResult from compliance.types.ts.
